_README: Item Group membership, defined as DATA rather than hard-coded in Python.
Each group resolves to a set of catalog items three ways, applied in order:
code_prefixes  every item whose `code` starts with one of these. This is
the baseline and it is DERIVABLE -- add a new BAL- item to
the catalog and it joins XRN-Balloons automatically, with
no list to maintain and nothing to drift.
include_codes  cross-family items a prefix cannot capture. An exploding
balloon wall needs pyro; a laser show needs a technician.
These are judgement calls and must be stated explicitly.
exclude_codes  items matching the prefix that do not belong.
Selecting by code prefix rather than by category is deliberate. The API
reports only a category's LEAF name and 16 leaf names collide across
different parents (Chapter 3 2.3.2), so category selection is ambiguous.
It also sweeps in test fixtures: `Balloons / Latex` holds 11 zz-test items,
so a category-derived Balloons group would be 20 items, 11 of them junk.
The ZZZ- prefix excludes them for free.
Prefix discipline is the dependency. A mistyped prefix silently drops an
item from its group with no error. Known offenders as of 2026-08-23:
BAL-FLY        missing the -NNN suffix
BAL-HEL-08F    non-numeric suffix
BAL-HEL-12F    non-numeric suffix
PYRO-FIR-REAL  PYRO- rather than PYR-, so it misses a PYR- filter
Catalog prefixes present 2026-08-23, by count:
LED 40, HG 29, ROB 27, SVC 26, PYR 17, LSR 15, PRO 14, TNK 13,
SHP 11, ZZZ 11, CNF 9, FOG 9, EQP 9, DRN 8, BAL 8, T&E 8,
WTR 7, FIN 6, AI 4, DMX 4, SNO 3, SPH 2
